value.rationale: Cesaro mixing rank is a motivated quantum-transport invariant singled out in the 2024 survey. The result classifies all Qr square Kq with q>=3 and reveals a discrete resonance restoring modes only at q=4m+2 and binary dimension r>=q/2; the first new surviving five-dimensional eigenspace is not inferred from separately averaged factors. A natural all-parameter exact boundary, not an arbitrary finite enumeration.
